comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
When you have received Northeastern Passage Development Award from Mercator after charting the entire Northeast Passage, you may open the Award and choose between this male only item, or a female-only Fur Overcoat. Both have the following stats:

+2 Perfume Trading
+1 Luxuries Trading
+1 Sociability
30,000 fame to equip
